Use case: identity-preserve. Single production animation sprite, not a sheet.
Inputs: image1 is the exact N idle identity, proportions and camera reference; image2 is corresponding historical walk pose to improve into actual RUNNING; image3 is front identity reference only (never copy its front camera); image4 is the approved primary painted STYLE reference, not UI content.
Create exactly one independent high-definition RUN pose of the same snow summoner girl. NORTH, exactly rear view walking/running away toward screen top, no face visible. Anatomical LEFT is screen LEFT; anatomical RIGHT is screen RIGHT. Keep the back of white/lilac short coat with purple BACK BOW; silver fox-face belt buckle only exists on FRONT, never add one to the back. Short silver-white bob, two furry ears, left-temple snowflake pin, same fluffy collar and short skirt, thigh/knee skin, same short fur boots. No extra tail on girl. ANATOMICAL LEFT arm continuously cradles exactly one little white fox against left ribs, left hand supports it. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand palm-up continuously supports the same small blue snowflake crystal. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs total, no unused extra arms. Preserve hands and props on their own sides; natural shoulder/elbow motion even while holding props.
POSE 03 LEFT leg compressed at lowest stance under hip, RIGHT folded knee passes beside support knee without crossing legs. RIGHT shoulder returns toward neutral, palm/crystal by waist.
The legs must create a fast running stride with genuine forward travel, torso leans slightly forward, not walking and not a standing display of the crystal. Natural perspective foreshortening; feet stay aligned with the running direction, clear left/right support and swing. Robe follows hips and exposes the two knees/boots enough to read motion. Continuous small fox bob, robe/tassel follow-through.
Maintain the exact idle size and full-body framing: square transparent canvas, total character resting height roughly82% of canvas, top ear about10% from top, virtual ground92% canvas, hip centre x50%. Leave all ears, sleeves, crystal, boots and tassels safely inside canvas with clear margin. DO NOT zoom, enlarge head or crop, no ground shadow or backdrop. Clean bright rounded high-end Chinese Daoist chibi hand-painted look matching supplied identity and approved style. True RGBA transparency. No text, no particles, no motion blur, no duplicates or ghosts.
Ground-contact constraint: this is a ONE-LEG SUPPORT pose. LEFT boot visibly contacts the virtual floor at 92% canvas height; supporting knee compresses, while the OTHER boot is lifted at least 8% canvas height above that floor. At push-off only the supporting toe stays on floor. No broad airborne split during support. Near/far projection must not reverse anatomical leg. RIGHT shoulder and elbow must change as specified, not just fingers/crystal orientation.
